searchText: Does anyone anticipate a spike in gas/txs the first few days of the merge? How do you think it may be related to the Merge? Maybe because of publicity, but it wouldn't have anything to *actually* do with The Merge. Or any DeFi/NFT activity that might be somehow related to/caused by the Merge? Yeah that’s what I was thinking. Was wondering how much publicity is going to pump gas. I guess it’s unlikely unless there’s a big nft drop celebrating it
